name: Jano Bistro

menus.name: Jano Experience degustation menu
menus.note: Six courses plus extras, with optional beverage matches. The only menu on Saturdays; the menu changes every 6 to 8 weeks.

bookingOpens: Online through Now Book It for up to 8 guests; a credit card pre-authorisation secures the booking. Dinner Wednesday to Saturday from 5.30pm; closed on public holidays except Anzac Day.
groups: Groups of 9 or more use the booking form, preferably from 7.30pm, with a set menu and a deposit. The private dining room seats up to 12 at one table or 14 at two; bookings outside opening hours need a deposit and minimum spend.
